text:
Jules: Heads-up — Olive is getting married on May 16th and a few of us are putting together a surprise send-off 🎉
Jules: Plan is: small after-work gathering at the rooftop + group card + Amazon gift (suggestion: Echo Dot + kitchen stuff). Would love a few volunteers to help with logistics.
Ari: count me in for decorations and grabbing a cake 🍰
Priya (People Ops): I can coordinate the card and get a budget sign-off for a boxed gift. How much were people thinking?
Samir: happy to chip in $25-40. If we need more I can front it and people can Venmo.
Anita: I can bring a camera and help with setup. Rooftop ok? Need a rain backup?
Jules: Rooftop at 6:30pm sounds good. Rain plan is the 3rd-floor lounge — reserved via calendar.
Max: :white_check_mark: in-person yes. If anyone remote wants to contribute, we can order a digital gift card too.
GiftingBot: Suggested amount per person based on 20 contributors: $30 avg -> Total $600. Create contribution link? (yes/no)
Priya (People Ops): I'll make a simple contribution tracker and drop the link here. Also checking dietary restrictions for cake.
Jules: Quick poll: react with :ballot_box_with_check: if you can make it in person, :money_with_wings: if you can only contribute money.
Samir: :ballot_box_with_check:
Ari: :ballot_box_with_check:
Anita: :ballot_box_with_check: :camera_with_flash:
Max: :money_with_wings:
Priya (People Ops): :ballot_box_with_check: (will be there to wrangle logistics)
Jules: Here's the gift wishlist link: https://bit.ly/olive-wedding-gift (please don't share with Olive)
Priya (People Ops): Contribution tracker (edit):
```
- Contributors: Samir, Ari, Anita, Max, Jules, Priya
- Target per person: $30
- Total target: $300
- Payment methods: Venmo/PayPal/Company pooled card
- Deadline: May 10
```
Samir: proposed message for the card: "So excited for you Olive — we love you! — Your Redwood fam" (ok?)
Ari: perfect and short :)
Anita: also thinking a short roast slide in the send-off? 1-2 funny photos. anyone got pics?
Jules: yes please add pics to the shared folder. I'll DM the folder link to folks who RSVP.
Priya (People Ops): I'll post the final RSVP + contribution link by tomorrow. Thanks everyone! :confetti_ball:
Jules: Awesome — super quick: if you can't be there but want to record a 15s message, send it to me and I'll compile.
Max: will do. Congrats Olive in advance 🥂
Ari: love this, thanks for organizing Jules
GiftingBot: Contribution link created: https://payments.example.com/collect/olive-wedding-1768509123
Jules: Closing note — stealth mode ON. Please avoid posting anything public about the wedding until after the surprise.
Priya (People Ops): Noted. If anyone needs a discreet way to contribute, DM me.
Anita: excited!!
Jules: thanks team — will post updates here.
